heading: Holiday Markets, Lights & Christmas Events in the Okanagan, 2026
title: Okanagan Christmas & Holiday Events 2026 | Okanagan Roam
description: Christmas markets, light-ups, The Nutcracker, holiday concerts, the Christmas Express steam train, sleigh rides and New Year's Eve in the Okanagan, 2026.
intro: This guide covers the 2026 holiday season, from mid-November through New Year's Day. It gathers the festive events in our listings: holiday markets, tree lightings and light-ups, Christmas concerts, Santa and family days at the ski hills, cozy winery evenings and a few ways to ring in 2027. Dates and details can change, so check each event page before you go.
Events are grouped by type. Each one shows its town and date.

items.name: Yuletide @ the PTCC
items.text: a three-day holiday market with local artisans, gift vendors and specialty food sellers, plus the kids-only Little Elf Shop. Admission is $3 a day.

items.name: Christmas at the Laurel
items.text: a European-style holiday market in the historic Laurel Packinghouse, with handmade gifts from local artisans and festive treats. Admission is by donation to the Food Bank.

items.name: It's Christmas @ the Red Barn
items.text: more than 50 local makers selling clothing, gourmet foods, body products, jewelry and home decor. Free admission; Food Bank donations welcome.

items.name: Delta Grand Holiday Market
items.text: at Delta Hotels by Marriott Grand Okanagan Resort, 10 am to 4 pm. Admission is by donation.

items.name: Holiday Magic Market
items.text: at the Rotary Centre for the Arts, 1 to 7 pm. Admission is by donation.

items.name: Christmas Faire
items.text: at the OSCA Osoyoos Activity Centre.

items.name: Craft Culture Holiday Market
items.text: at Prospera Place, 1 to 7 pm on Dec 4. Admission is $7.

items.name: Christkindl Holiday Market
items.text: a traditional European-style Christmas market back at the Laurel Packinghouse, with handmade local gifts, festive treats and hot cider. Admission is by donation to the Food Bank.

items.name: The Last Chance Holiday Market
items.text: handmade gifts from local artisans, specialty foods and festive treats, billed as the last local shopping stop before Christmas. Admission is $3 at the door.

items.name: Festival of Trees at Mission Hill
items.text: a festive display of community-decorated holiday trees, with a guided experience and seasonal wine tasting supporting BC Children's Hospital. This is the 10th annual Festival of Trees.

items.name: Tree of Hope Festival
items.text: the annual tree-lighting tradition in the Landmark District, with festive entertainment, seasonal treats and family-friendly activities. The organizer will announce the detailed schedule closer to the date.

items.name: Magic on Main Street: Santa Claus Parade & Light Up
items.text: the Santa Claus Parade travels down Main Street to Gyro Park for the official downtown light-up, with Santa, a 180-foot light tunnel and a giant “light brite”. Parade at 4:30 pm, light-up at 6 pm; free.

items.name: West Kelowna Light Up 2026
items.text: the City of West Kelowna's brightest event of the year, at Westbank Centre from 5 to 8 pm, with holiday lights, entertainment and family activities.

items.name: SilverStar Annual Light Up
items.text: help light up the village at SilverStar Mountain Resort's annual Light Up celebration.

items.name: Big White's Twinkling Trail Light Up
items.text: at Big White Ski Resort.

items.name: Matt Dusk – A Very Sinatra Christmas
items.text: at Creekside Theatre, ticketed through the theatre's box office.

items.name: A 1940s Radio Christmas Carol
items.text: a comedy in which a WWII-era troupe performs a live radio broadcast of A Christmas Carol, complete with vintage carols, mock commercials and backstage mishaps, at the Powerhouse Theatre.

items.name: A Celtic Family Christmas Party
items.text: at Kelowna Community Theatre, 7:30 pm. Admission is $70.21.

items.name: Disney's Frozen the Musical
items.text: a family musical at the Actors Studio and Dinner Theatre, 7 pm. Admission: $72-$99.

items.name: The Celtic Tenors: A Celtic Christmas
items.text: at the Vernon District & Performing Arts Centre, 7:30 to 9:30 pm.

items.name: The Celtic Tenors: A Celtic Christmas
items.text: at Venables Theatre, 7:30 pm.

items.name: Summerland Strummers Christmas Carol Singalong
items.text: at the Summerland Community Centre, starting at 7 pm. Confirm tickets with the venue.

items.name: The Nutcracker: Mission Dance Company
items.text: Mission Dance Company, with guest dancers from Okanagan Ballet Theatre, performs a family-friendly, two-hour Nutcracker with live narration, at the Vernon & District Performing Arts Centre. Shows at 2 pm and 7 pm.

items.name: Oh Come All Ye Soulful
items.text: at Creekside Theatre, ticketed through the theatre's box office.

items.name: Freya & Friends: Okanagan Symphony Holiday Concert
items.text: the Okanagan Symphony Orchestra’s holiday concert with the folk duo Freya, Okanagan composer, pianist and vocalist Leila Naderi, and the Okanagan Symphony Chorus. It plays {event:kelowna/freya-friends-live|Kelowna} on Dec 18, Penticton’s Cleland Theatre on Dec 19 and {event:vernon/freya-friends-okanagan-symphony-holiday-concert|Vernon} on Dec 20.

items.name: Stars on Ice Holiday Tour
items.text: a holiday edition of Stars on Ice, with Olympic, World and National champion figure skaters performing holiday-themed programs, at Kal Tire Place.

items.name: South Okanagan Big Band — Jazzy Christmas
items.text: at the Summerland Community Centre, starting at 7 pm. Confirm tickets with the venue.

items.name: A Coast-to-Coast Cowboy Christmas with George Canyon & Aaron Pritchett
items.text: at the Vernon District & Performing Arts Centre, 7:30 to 9:30 pm.

items.name: Wine Tasting: The Heart of Wine Country™ Holiday Cheer Open House
items.text: at various wineries throughout the Okanagan Falls and Skaha region, 11 am to 4 pm.

items.name: Workshop: Holiday Wreath Workshop and Barrel Sampling @ Noble Ridge Vineyard and Winery
items.text: at Noble Ridge Vineyard and Winery, 1 to 3 pm.

items.name: Holiday Mingle
items.text: at Phantom Creek Estates, noon to 4 pm.

items.name: Christmas Gnome Workshop
items.text: at Gray Monk Estate Winery.

items.name: Okanagan Winery Holiday Dinner
items.text: at The Sonora Room Restaurant at Burrowing Owl Estate Winery, 6 to 9 pm.

items.name: Poinsettia Ornament Workshop
items.text: at Phantom Creek Estates, 2 to 4 pm.

items.name: Holiday Paint & Sip: Christmas Tree Charcuterie Board
items.text: at Sandhill Wines, 5:30 to 8:30 pm. Admission is $75.

items.name: Welcome to Winter at Big White
items.text: the resort's season-opening celebration in the village, with family activities and festivities, 5 to 7:05 pm.

items.name: Christmas Express
items.text: a one-hour holiday ride on the Kettle Valley Steam Railway, with Christmas lights aboard the 3716 locomotive, music, carols, a hot drink and Santa. Departures at 4:30 and 6:30 pm; book ahead.

items.name: West Kelowna Winterfest
items.text: a free family winter weekend at the Mount Boucherie Community Centre, including storytime with Santa and skating with Santa.

items.name: Christmas Sleigh Rides at Ottercrest Farms
items.text: horse-drawn Christmas sleigh rides on select December afternoons, with rides every half hour.

items.name: Christmas Dinner and Dance
items.text: at the OSCA Osoyoos Activity Centre.

items.name: Christmas Themed Bingo
items.text: at the OSCA Osoyoos Activity Centre.

items.name: Santa's Workshop
items.text: at Big White Ski Resort.

items.name: SilverStar 12 Days of Holidays
items.text: SilverStar's holiday programme in the village.

items.name: Big White's Christmas Eve Festival
items.text: at Big White Ski Resort.

items.name: Ski with Santa
items.text: at Big White Ski Resort.

items.name: Xmas Fusion DJ Night
items.text: at Revelry Food+Music Hub, 7 pm to 1 am. Admission is $15 to $70.

sections.heading: New Year's Eve & New Year's Day

items.name: SilverStar New Year’s Eve
items.text: cheers to the New Year in SilverStar Village.

items.name: NYE!! The Justin Glibbery Sextet at the Vernon Jazz Club
items.text: at the Vernon Jazz Club, 9 pm to 11:59 pm.

items.name: Polar Bear Dip
items.text: at Tugboat Beach in Waterfront Park, 1 to 2:30 pm. Admission is $15.
